caniuse-lite.reason: Browser-compatibility data table required by Next.js/browserslist at build time; an attribution-only data license, not copyleft or source-available (KOBE-5 review).

argparse.reason: Pulled in by js-yaml (via @kubernetes/client-node). PSF-2.0 is a permissive BSD-style license, not copyleft or source-available (KOBE-6).

khroma.reason: CSS colour helpers pulled in by mermaid (KOBE-130). The MIT license is in the repository and its npm metadata, but package.json has no license field, so a fresh pnpm store reports Unknown.
